title: Nobody is switching between these. Watch.
caption:
Anthropic updated Claude Code to run multiple coding projects at once, with a live status view for each.

The desktop app now starts sessions faster and lets users split work across several at once.
A demo showed three projects running simultaneously with tasks marked working, needs-input, or completed.
The update post got over 2 million views on X in two days.
